expo.name: National Parks Guide

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: With your permission, National Parks Guide can privately check a location during a visitor challenge. We do not continuously track you or store raw GPS coordinates.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow National Parks Guide to check your location only while you voluntarily complete a park challenge. No background tracking.

expo.description: Independent National Parks Guide iOS/Android app, with visitor discovery, responsible travel and opt-in GPS. Not affiliated with NPS.
